user.title: Food Diary
user.description: A calorie and macro diary for one person. Log food from a meal photo, a nutrition label, a barcode, words or a recipe.

data_description.person: Whose diary this is. Each person can have one diary.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Reads meal photos, labels and descriptions. Leave empty to use your default AI Task entity.
data_description.notify_service: Gets a notification such as “Logged: Porridge · 215 kcal · 1,030 left today”, with Undo, when food is logged by voice or through the webhook.
data_description.open_path: A dashboard path such as /lovelace/food. The notification's Change button opens it.
data_description.meal_plan_sensor: Optional. A sensor whose `week` attribute lists planned meals; they count in the diary ahead of time. See the docs for the attribute format.
data_description.dishes_sensor: Optional. A sensor whose `dishes` attribute lists recipes; it gives planned meals their numbers and turns on the recipe numbers check. See the docs for the attribute format.
data_description.source: Optional. Another integration that offers its recipes and meal plan. When set, it is used instead of the two sensors.

abort.already_configured: This person already has a food diary.

init.title: Food Diary options
init.description: Webhook address for phone shortcuts (keep it private; anyone with it can log food to this diary): {webhook_url}

data_description.ai_task_entity: Reads meal photos, labels and descriptions. Leave empty to use your default AI Task entity.
data_description.notify_service: Gets a notification such as “Logged: Porridge · 215 kcal · 1,030 left today”, with Undo, when food is logged by voice or through the webhook.
data_description.open_path: A dashboard path such as /lovelace/food. The notification's Change button opens it.
data_description.meal_plan_sensor: Optional. A sensor whose `week` attribute lists planned meals; they count in the diary ahead of time. See the docs for the attribute format.
data_description.dishes_sensor: Optional. A sensor whose `dishes` attribute lists recipes; it gives planned meals their numbers and turns on the recipe numbers check. See the docs for the attribute format.
data_description.source: Optional. Another integration that offers its recipes and meal plan. When set, it is used instead of the two sensors.

log_food.name: Log food
log_food.description: Add something to a food diary. Give kcal (and macros) for one portion, or per_100 with grams.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

name.name: Name
name.description: What it is. Leave out for a batch (source batch, ref its id): the batch's name.

veg_g.name: Veg
veg_g.description: Grams of vegetables and pulses (beans, lentils, chickpeas) in one portion; potatoes and fruit don't count. Leave out when not known.

meal.name: Meal
meal.description: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack. Leave out to go by the time of day.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the numbers came from: photo, label, barcode, text, dish, manual, again, saved, voice, import, batch or estimate.

ref.name: Reference
ref.description: A recipe id, for food from a recipe.

note.name: Note
note.description: A short note, like “1 bowl, about 350 g”.

per_100.name: Per 100 g
per_100.description: kcal (needed, 0 for water), protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fibre_g per 100 g or ml, and unknown: the macros not known.

grams.name: Grams
grams.description: How much was eaten, with per_100 (more than 0).

edited.name: Own numbers
edited.description: Mark the numbers as typed in by hand.

photo.name: Photo
photo.description: The photo file an estimate returned (kept with the entry).

image_url.name: Product photo
image_url.description: An https picture of the product (from Open Food Facts, say).

client_id.name: Client ID
client_id.description: An id your app makes for this one action (8–64 letters, digits, - or _; a UUID is fine). Sending the same id again returns the first result, with duplicate: true, instead of adding again. The same id with different data is refused.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: Macros not known for this food (protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fibre_g), as an estimate, a saved meal or a recent food lists them. A macro left out is unknown too; a 0 that is sent is known.

plan_key.name: Plan key
plan_key.description: Puts a planned meal back (Undo after deleting it): the entry's plan_key as it was (date|meal, e.g. 2026-10-11|dinner, or a planned side's date|meal|side:n). Kept only when it matches the entry's date and meal; a meal plan that follows the diary puts that meal back on the plan.

update_food.name: Change food
update_food.description: Change an entry: portions, grams, meal, name, your own numbers for the whole entry, switch it to by weight (per_100 with grams), or mark it as checked.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The entry's day. Leave out for today.

grams.name: Grams
grams.description: New amount, for entries with per-100 values (or with per_100, to switch to by weight).

kcal.name: Calories
kcal.description: Your own kcal for the whole entry.

protein_g.name: Protein
protein_g.description: Your own grams for the whole entry.

carbs_g.name: Carbs
carbs_g.description: Your own grams for the whole entry.

fat_g.name: Fat
fat_g.description: Your own grams for the whole entry.

fibre_g.name: Fibre
fibre_g.description: Your own grams for the whole entry.

veg_g.name: Veg
veg_g.description: Your own grams of vegetables and pulses for the whole entry.

checked.name: Checked
checked.description: Mark the entry as confirmed right (for example, a likely double entry that isn't one). False clears it.

unknown.name: Unknown
unknown.description: Macros to mark as not known again (protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fibre_g), stored as 0: Undo after a fix that gave them. Wins over a number sent for the same macro.

per_100.name: Per 100
per_100.description: With grams: the entry by weight from now on, its numbers per 100 g or ml (kcal needed; unknown lists macros not known). Keeps its name, meal, photo and source.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: g or ml: what per_100 is per (with per_100).

edited.name: Your own numbers
edited.description: With per_100: true when it was worked out from your own corrected numbers.

expected_rev.name: Expected revision
expected_rev.description: The entry's rev as you last saw it. If the entry has changed since, nothing changes and the action fails with a conflict.

restore_food.name: Undo a change to food
restore_food.description: Puts an entry back exactly as update_food's before gave it (with a new revision). Fails with a conflict if it changed since.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The entry's day. Leave out for today.

expected_rev.name: Expected revision
expected_rev.description: The rev update_food's answer gave the entry. If it has changed since, nothing changes and the action fails with a conflict.

delete_food.name: Remove food
delete_food.description: Take an entry out of a food diary.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The entry's day. Leave out for today.

expected_rev.name: Expected revision
expected_rev.description: The entry's rev as you last saw it. If the entry has changed since, nothing changes and the action fails with a conflict.

get_day.name: Get a day
get_day.description: A day's entries, totals, goals, what's left and each meal's calories.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Daily totals for the days up to a date.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

get_recent.name: Get recent foods
get_recent.description: Foods logged in the last 60 days (most often first, ready to log again), the usual foods per meal (logged on 3 or more of the last 28 days) and saved meals.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

limit.name: How many
limit.description: How many foods to return (30 unless asked; up to 200, for searching).

set_goals.name: Set goals
set_goals.description: Daily goals for calories and macros.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

estimate.name: Estimate
estimate.description: Work out what something is and its nutrition, without logging it: a meal photo, a label photo and amount, a barcode and amount, words, a recipe or a dish eaten out, a batch's raw ingredients, one food per 100 g, or a menu.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary (for its AI setting). Leave out for your own.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: photo, label, barcode, text, dish, ingredients, per_100 or menu.

image.name: Photo
image.description: Base64 JPEG or PNG (photo and label).

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: What was eaten: “3 biscuits”, “50 g”, “half the pack” (label and barcode).

hint.name: Hint
hint.description: Anything to help with a meal photo, a menu, a food's name (per_100) or a dish eaten out (like at the place's name).

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: EAN or UPC digits (barcode; optional with label).

dish_id.name: Recipe id
dish_id.description: The recipe's id (dish). Its answer is kept. Leave out for a dish eaten out, by its name.

dish_name.name: Recipe name
dish_name.description: The recipe's name (dish), or the batch's (ingredients).

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: The recipe's ingredients with amounts, one per item (dish).

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: How many portions the recipe makes (dish).

fresh.name: Work it out again
fresh.description: Ignore the kept answer for this recipe.

items.name: Ingredients to work out
items.description: A batch's raw ingredients (ingredients), at most 30: each a name with grams, or an amount like 1 onion.

name.name: Food
name.description: The food's name (per_100): its numbers per 100 g, or 100 ml for a drink, as eaten. Or a dish eaten out (dish without a recipe id).

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: What a meal photo's food is on, so portions are sized against it: kind plate or bowl, and cm across (10 to 40).

media.name: Menu photos
media.description: One to four base64 photos of a menu (menu).

get_dish_nutrition.name: Get recipe nutrition
get_dish_nutrition.description: The kept nutrition for one portion of a recipe.

set_dish_nutrition.name: Set recipe nutrition
set_dish_nutrition.description: Nutrition for one portion of a recipe: your own numbers, or what the recipe prints. Its diary entries from today on that you haven't changed follow, and any doubt about its numbers goes.

source.name: Source
source.description: own (your numbers, never doubted), recipe (printed on the recipe) or ai.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: How many portions the recipe makes.

save_meal.name: Save a meal
save_meal.description: Keeps everything logged in one meal on one day as one thing to log again (the same name replaces an older one).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

name.name: Name
name.description: What to call it, like My usual breakfast.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it's on. Leave out for today.

foods.name: Foods
foods.description: Save these foods (each a name and its numbers) instead of what's logged in that meal.

update_saved_meal.name: Change a saved meal
update_saved_meal.description: Renames a saved meal or moves it to another meal (a name another saved meal has replaces that one).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

delete_saved_meal.name: Delete a saved meal
delete_saved_meal.description: Removes a saved meal (what's already logged stays).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

save_batch.name: Save a batch
save_batch.description: Keeps a batch cooked from weighed raw ingredients, to log bowls of it by weight (the same name on the same day replaces it).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it was cooked. Leave out for today.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Each a name, raw grams, per_100 (raw) and cooked_factor (cooked / raw weight).

cooked_g.name: Cooked weight
cooked_g.description: The whole pot weighed after cooking, in g. Leave out to estimate it from the ingredients.

recipe_id.name: Recipe id
recipe_id.description: The recipe it was cooked from, if any.

update_batch.name: Change a batch
update_batch.description: The pot's real cooked weight or how many portions it made; food logged from it follows.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

cooked_g.name: Cooked weight
cooked_g.description: The whole pot weighed after cooking, in g.

delete_batch.name: Delete a batch
delete_batch.description: Forgets a batch. Food logged from it stays.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

get_batches.name: Get batches
get_batches.description: Batches cooked lately, and the dishes batched before (one each, with its last batch).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

days.name: Days
days.description: Batches cooked today and the days before, this many days in all. Default 5.

get_week_review.name: Get a week's look back
get_week_review.description: A week ending on a date: days on target (75–105% of the calorie goal), average, protein days, the most eaten food, recipes tried for the first time, the day closest to the goal, each day's calories per meal, fibre and veg, and the week before's veg and fibre.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Last day
date.description: The week's last day. Leave out for yesterday.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back (7 for a week; up to 35).

set_fullness.name: Set fullness
set_fullness.description: How full you were a couple of hours after breakfast, lunch or dinner: hungry again, satisfied or still full. For today and the 7 days before.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The meal's day. Leave out for today.

fullness.name: Fullness
fullness.description: hungry, satisfied or full; empty (null) takes the answer back.

client_id.name: Client id
client_id.description: An id made for this one answer, so a retry sets it once.

get_fullness.name: Get fullness
get_fullness.description: The fullness answers of the last days, newest first, each with what that meal had in the diary.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

days.name: Days
days.description: Today and the days before, this many days in all. Default 60.

get_dishes.name: Get the recipes
get_dishes.description: The dish library's recipes, with each one's calories and macros per portion where the recipe book knows them. Empty when no dish library sensor is set.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

sync_plan.name: Sync the meal plan now
sync_plan.description: Brings this diary in line with the meal plan now (it also happens by itself a few seconds after the plan changes). Does nothing when no meal plan sensor is set.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

set_photo.name: Set a food's photo
set_photo.description: Adds your own photo to something already logged.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it's on. Leave out for today.

expected_rev.name: Expected revision
expected_rev.description: The entry's rev as you last saw it. If the entry has changed since, nothing changes and the action fails with a conflict.

copy_day.name: Copy a day
copy_day.description: Copies a day, or one meal of it, onto other days (planned food comes as plain food). With replace, what those days had there goes first. Returns a token for undo_copy.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

to.name: To
to.description: The days to copy it to.

meal.name: Meal
meal.description: Only this meal. Leave out for the whole day.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Take off what's already there first.

client_id.name: Client ID
client_id.description: An id your app makes for this one copy (8–64 letters, digits, - or _). Sending the same id again returns the first copy's result, with duplicate: true, instead of copying again.

undo_copy.name: Undo a copy
undo_copy.description: Puts the days back as they were before a copy_day (the last ten, until a restart).

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

check_numbers.name: Check numbers
check_numbers.description: Compares the numbers for a recipe (or a diary entry) with what its ingredients add up to, per portion.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Or a diary entry to check (with its date).

date.name: Date
date.description: The entry's day. Leave out for today.

portions.name: Portions
portions.description: How many portions the recipe makes.

dismiss_check.name: Numbers are right
dismiss_check.description: Confirms a recipe's numbers are right: its doubt goes and isn't raised again for these numbers.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

snapshot.name: Snapshot before a change
snapshot.description: Keeps exact copies of what a change made with other actions may touch (an entry, a recipe's numbers and its entries from today on), so restore_snapshot can undo it exactly. The last ten, until a restart.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

token.name: Token
token.description: A name for this snapshot (4–40 letters, digits, - or _), made by the caller.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: An entry the change may touch.

dish_id.name: Recipe ID
dish_id.description: A recipe whose numbers the change may set.

restore_snapshot.name: Undo with a snapshot
restore_snapshot.description: Puts back exactly what snapshot kept: the entries (with a new revision) and the recipe's numbers. Once per token.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Leave out for your own (or the only one).

rename_source.name: Rename a source
rename_source.description: Gives every entry and recipe with one source another (for example food brought over from another app → import). Admin only.

from.name: From
from.description: The source name in the stored data.

client_id_reused.message: That client_id was already used for a different request. Make a new id for each action.

conflict.message: That entry has changed since you last saw it. Reload it and try again.
